The '''''Fearless''''' is a [[Seanchan]] ship, captained by [[Egeanin Tamarath]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Fearless}}

==Activities==
Egeanin Tamarath commanded the ''Fearless'' from [[Seanchan (continent)|Seanchan]] to [[Falme]].{{ref/book|10|2}} The ''Fearless'' was the ship that caught the ''[[Spray]]'' and captured [[Bayle Domon]] and his crew.{{ref/book|2|29}}
